workflow: When a CI fix doesn't clear the failure, read the new failure log before iterating rather than assuming the same cause.
Check release assets of a tool before assuming an installer action provides it.
Verifying checksums when installing tools from release tarballs in CI is preferable to trusting unpinned installers.
